reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

bg=9
out=[[bg for _ in range(13)] for __ in range(13)]
# Each 5x5 square is placed with its one-cell frame, and its matching 3x3 pattern is cut out in bg.
tiles=[
    (1,1,7,['##.','##.','..#']),
    (1,7,5,['#.#','###','.#.']),
    (7,1,3,['###','.#.','.#.']),
    (7,7,2,['#.#','##.','.#.']),
]
for r0,c0,color,mask in tiles:
    for r in range(5):
        for c in range(5): out[r0+r][c0+c]=color
    for r,row in enumerate(mask):
        for c,ch in enumerate(row):
            if ch=='#': out[r0+1+r][c0+1+c]=bg
print(len(out),len(out[0]))
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,r)) for r in out))
